macros.name: abstract
macros.doc: This macro defines the content of the abstract which should abide by SGS policy.

macros.name: acknowledgements
macros.doc: The acknowledgements and dedication pages are both optional, and defined by the respective commands \acknowledgements and \dedication.

macros.name: addtoreferences
macros.doc: Each call to \addtoreferences will append another bib input file to the list of files to load.

macros.name: appendix
macros.doc: The book class \appendix command has been redefined to take an argument to specify the appendices.

macros.name: declaration
macros.doc: The \declaration is used to define the authors declaration of sole authorship and Ryerson’s right to reproduction and distribution of the document.

macros.name: dedication
macros.doc: The acknowledgements and dedication pages are both optional, and defined by the respective commands \acknowledgements and \dedication.

macros.name: degreeName
macros.doc: The full name of your degree (e.g. Doctor of Philosophy, Masters of Applied Science).

macros.name: degreeYear
macros.doc: The year that the degree will be awarded, typically the year of convocation.

macros.name: partnerUniversity
macros.doc: The name of any partner University or school affiliated with the granting of this degree.

macros.name: prevDegreeA
macros.doc: The full name, location and year of any previous completed degrees, starting with the most recent (\prevDegreeA) through to the oldest (\prevDegreeD).

macros.name: prevDegreeC
macros.doc: The full name, location and year of any previous completed degrees, starting with the most recent (\prevDegreeA) through to the oldest (\prevDegreeD).

macros.name: prevDegreeD
macros.doc: The full name, location and year of any previous completed degrees, starting with the most recent (\prevDegreeA) through to the oldest (\prevDegreeD).

macros.name: program
macros.doc: The program or department which is awarding the degree.

macros.name: usereferences
macros.doc: The \usereferences command is used to label the bibliographic section as “References” by default.
